content: {"like":["Enjoys strong, charismatic performances in horror slasher films (e.g., Danielle Harris, Derek Mears, Kane Hodder).","Prefers horror movies with practical, campy humor and nostalgic 80s vibes (e.g., Gremlins).","Values psychological depth and philosophical themes in non‑horror dramas (e.g., Hector and the Search for Happiness).","Appreciates well‑executed gore and inventive kill scenes in slasher‑style movies (e.g., To All a Goodnight).","Enjoys unpredictable, non‑predictable plot twists in thriller‑comedy hybrids (e.g., Better Watch Out)."],"dislike":["Dislikes inexperienced directors and poor direction in horror sequels (e.g., Hatchet III).","Avoids films lacking humor, camp, or sexual content in horror (e.g., Hatchet III).","Rejects slow pacing, vague plots, and lack of character development in dramas (e.g., A Ghost Story).","Dislikes absurd, out‑of‑place events and lack of gore or nudity in thriller‑comedy (e.g., Better Watch Out).","Dislikes incoherent, amateurish production and flat characters in anthology horror (e.g., Xmas Tales)."]}
